# Function to generate a new valid chain extender molecule in SMILES format
def generate_chain_extender():
    # Possible extensions for the base structure "O"
    extensions = [
        "CC",
        "C(C)",
        "C(C)C",
        "N",
        "N(C(=O)CO)",
        "N(C(=O)OC)"
    ]
    
    # Select two random extensions and combine them with the base structure
    import random
    extension1 = random.choice(extensions)
    extension2 = random.choice(extensions)
    
    # Combine the base structure with the selected extensions
    smiles = f"O{extension1}{extension2}"
    
    return smiles

# Generate a new chain extender molecule
new_molecule = generate_chain_extender()
print(new_molecule)
